setup.title: LumiBase Setup
setup.subtitle: Configure your instance for the first time.

account.label: Account
account.title: Create the admin account
account.longDescription: This account becomes the bootstrap administrator for the instance. Pick a strong, unique password — it can't be reset without recovery codes.

strength.insufficient: Choose a password rated "Strong" or better to continue.

path.label: Path
path.title: Choose a private admin path
path.description: Pick a private URL for the Studio admin surface.
path.longDescription: Pick a URL slug that bots won't guess. The Studio will only respond at this path; everything else returns 404.

adminPath.label: Admin path
adminPath.help: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. 4–64 characters after the leading slash.

path.generateError: Couldn't generate a unique path. Try again or enter one manually.

warning.title: Save this path.
warning.body: Losing it means running the recovery flow with one of your backup codes. Bookmark the URL, store it in your password manager, or write it down somewhere safe before continuing.

path.confirmCheckbox: I have saved my admin path. I understand losing it requires the recovery flow.

security.label: Security
security.title: Configure login security
security.description: Configure login lockout and anomaly detection.
security.longDescription: Set thresholds for failed login attempts and choose how aggressively to react to suspicious sign-ins.

preset.label: Preset
preset.help: Apply default values to every group below. You can fine-tune after picking a preset.
preset.standardDescription: Balanced defaults suitable for most teams.

failedAttempts.title: Failed Attempts
failedAttempts.description: How many failed sign-ins to tolerate before locking a user or blocking an IP.

userMaxFailedAttempts.label: Per-user max attempts
userMaxFailedAttempts.help: Lock a user after this many failed attempts within the window. Range 3–20.

userLockoutDurationSeconds.label: User lockout duration (seconds)
userLockoutDurationSeconds.help: How long to keep a user locked. Range 60–86400.

ipMaxFailedAttempts.label: Per-IP max attempts
ipMaxFailedAttempts.help: Block an IP after this many failed attempts within the window. Range 5–100.

ipLockoutDurationSeconds.label: IP lockout duration (seconds)
ipLockoutDurationSeconds.help: How long to keep an IP blocked. Range 60–86400.

lockoutWindowSeconds.label: Sliding window (seconds)
lockoutWindowSeconds.help: Counter window for tallying failed attempts. Range 60–86400.

geo.title: Geographic Anomaly
geo.description: Flag sign-ins from countries the user hasn't logged in from before.
geo.warningGeoipUnavailable: GeoIP database is unavailable on this instance; geographic anomaly detection will stay off until you install it.

time.title: Time Anomaly
time.description: Flag sign-ins at hours the user rarely logs in.

device.title: Device Anomaly
device.description: Flag sign-ins from a User-Agent / device fingerprint the user hasn't used before.

anomalyAction.title: Anomaly Action
anomalyAction.description: What the system should do when a sign-in's anomaly score crosses the threshold.

anomalyAction.label: Action
anomalyAction.mfaDisabledHelp: MFA module is not installed; this option is unavailable for now.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Where to send security event notifications.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.title: Save your backup codes
recovery.description: Save backup codes for emergency access.
recovery.longDescription: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to recover the bootstrap admin if you lose your password or admin path.

actions.copyError: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the codes above and copy them manually.

recovery.confirmCheckbox: I have saved these backup codes.

done.label: Done
done.title: Setup complete
done.description: Setup complete — bookmark your admin URL.
done.longDescription: Your LumiBase instance is initialised. Save the admin URL below before navigating away.
done.copyError: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the path above and copy it manually.
done.savePathReminder: Save this URL as a bookmark. Without it, you'll need to run the recovery flow with one of your backup codes.

noAdminPath.title: No setup in progress
noAdminPath.body: We couldn't find a completed setup in this browser session. Start the wizard from the beginning to configure your instance.

retry.title: Couldn't reach the server
retry.body: We couldn't check whether this instance has been set up yet. Make sure the LumiBase backend is running, then try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

tokenPrompt.title: Setup token required
tokenPrompt.body: This instance was started with LUMIBASE_REQUIRE_SETUP_TOKEN=true. Paste the one-time setup token printed in the CMS startup logs to continue.
tokenPrompt.label: Setup token

errors.validation: Please correct the highlighted fields before continuing.
errors.server: The server returned an error. Try again or check the CMS logs.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.initialized: This instance is already set up. The wizard is no longer available.
errors.tokenRequired: Paste the one-time setup token from the CMS startup logs.
errors.tokenInvalid: That setup token isn't valid. Check the CMS logs for the latest one.
errors.alreadyInitialized: Setup is already complete on this instance.
errors.setupInProgress: Another browser tab is already running setup. Finish it there or wait a few seconds.

password.tooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
password.missingClasses: Password must include lowercase, uppercase, digit, and a special character.
password.weak: Choose a password rated "Strong" or better.

adminPath.invalidFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. 4–64 characters after the leading slash.
adminPath.predictable: This path is too predictable. Choose another.
adminPath.reserved: This path conflicts with a system route. Choose another.

policy.ipMaxFailedAttempts: Must be at least 3 and no more than 100.

shared.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
shared.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again or contact your administrator.

backupCode.title: Recover access with a backup code
backupCode.subtitle: Enter your bootstrap admin email and one of the 8 backup codes you saved during setup.

errors.invalid: That email or backup code didn't match.
errors.alreadyUsed: That backup code has already been used.

success.title: Account unlocked
success.body: Your account is unlocked. Use the URL below to sign in. Save it — you'll need it next time.

forgotPath.title: Forgot your admin path?
forgotPath.subtitle: Enter the bootstrap admin email. If it matches and email is configured, we'll send a recovery link.
forgotPath.sent: If the email matches the bootstrap admin, a recovery link has been sent.
forgotPath.linkToBackupCode: Have a backup code instead? Use it here.
